text: {"lessons":["Selling stocks A, C, D, and E after gains felt satisfying, but a gain over my average cost alone is not a reason to sell; I should consider each holding's role in my overall account.","I should not treat each stock as a separate account or let avoiding a realized loss dictate my decisions; average cost is not a forecast of future prices.","The small account changes during the months I held steady remind me that short-term price moves are uncertain, so I should avoid trading just because prices have moved recently."]}
